provenance: ARC-AGI-Pub, OpenAI o3 (Dec 2024 preview). Reported estimates (NOT precise measurements): low-compute config (6 samples/task) 75.7% on the semi-private set at ~$2,012 total = ~$20/attempted task; high-compute config (1024 samples/task, 172x the compute) 87.5% at ~$346,000 total = ~$3,460/task (per-task dollars as compiled by Bender et al. 2025, arXiv:2501.07458, from ARC Prize's estimates). OpenAI never published official o3 pricing, and ARC Prize later revised its dollar estimates upward (toward ~$30,000/task for the high config) using more expensive proxy pricing — the token counts and the 172x multiplier are the stable facts; dollars are estimate-dependent. o1 reached at most ~32%. Human anchors from ARC Prize: ~$17/task reflects the actual data collected; the true limit of human cost efficiency is likely $2-5/task. x = estimated $/task; y = accuracy (%). Present as reported estimates.
